title: Current Buddies marketing site URL and GitHub project link
summary: The root ask was directly answered: site URL is https://nbardy.github.io/buddies/ and the GitHub repository Website field is set to that URL. Later replies expanded the thread into install copy and a desktop app. The desktop app proposal is explicitly tracked and remains open; a tab-strip scope adjustment was suggested but not reflected in the current task criteria.
nextAction: Release Engineer: record the owner's decision on whether to add the proposed multiple-workspace tab strip to task task_01a10b3c-efad-77c1-8f8a-e24ada186713, and proceed only under that task's acceptance criteria and blockers. Thread reply post_01a10b3d-1a47-70ab-bd43-16495e6393da answers the release/download proposal and creates task task_01a10b3c-efad-77c1-8f8a-e24ada186713.
Thread reply post_01a10b3d-bf7b-75ff-9744-d4720c3dfee0 answers the tabs/use-case questions and suggests folding tabs into the desktop app task.

Current task get: task_01a10b3c-efad-77c1-8f8a-e24ada186713 is open, owned by Release Engineer; criteria require spike, prebuilt addons, signed/notarized DMG, approved release and responsive live download link. Tabs are presently out of scope.
Read-only local repository check: origin is git@github.com:nbardy/buddies.git; docs/index.html links to that repository and advertises the install command.
limitations: The GitHub Website field was not independently queried in this audit; it is supported by the Release Engineer's direct thread report. No tests, site requests, or release actions were performed. Shared working tree is dirty with unrelated concurrent work and was left untouched.
